QUOTE: "**Default (no define):** external applications that include mbedtls headers. They cannot use the field names." and "**Opt-out:** the library itself and its own sample programs. Inside that code the field is accessed by its real name."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that code defining MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS sees plain names while ordinary consumers of the public headers see the renamed private_ members.
